subject: Re: Redwood for checkout personalization — quick intro & scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Cho <alex@stellarcart.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood for checkout personalization — demo request

Hi Rafael,

We signed up for the self-serve trial yesterday (team: checkout) and I wanted to see if we could get a short demo to understand how Redwood might fit into our personalization stack. Main goals: reduce checkout abandonment and A/B test product ranking at checkout.

Rough context:
- Platform: Ruby on Rails backend, React storefront
- Traffic: ~1.2M monthly pageviews, ~85k monthly checkouts
- Timeline: hoping to pilot in Q4 (target internal demo in the next 2–3 weeks)

Could you or someone on your team run through the product and help us evaluate fit? Appreciate pointers on expected latency/cost at ~10–15k monthly inference calls and what data we'd need to integrate.

Thanks,
Alex Cho
Head of Product
StellarCart

---
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Cho <alex@stellarcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood for checkout personalization — demo request

Hi Alex — great to meet you and glad you spun up a trial. I can run a 30-min tailored demo and cover integration points, latency/cost, and a short pilot playbook. Before we lock a time, two quick qualification questions so we make the session productive: 

1) What is your expected inference pattern? (e.g., 10–15k calls mostly at checkout peak times, or steady throughout the day?)
2) Do you need private deployment/VPC or is hosted API okay for the pilot?
3) Who else from StellarCart should join the demo (engineer, infra/security, PM)?

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu Aug 20 — 10:00–10:30am
- Thu Aug 20 — 3:00–3:30pm
- Fri Aug 21 — 11:00–11:30am

If none of those work, send me 2–3 windows that do and we’ll accommodate. I’ve looped Ben (SDR) to help get a calendar invite out and share a short pre-demo intake doc.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Alex Cho <alex@stellarcart.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lin <sara@stellarcart.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood for checkout personalization — demo request

Thanks Rafael — quick answers below: 

1) Volume: Target pilot is ~12k inference calls / month. Most traffic spikes are during promotional bursts (roughly 30% of daily traffic concentrated into 3–4 hour windows, usually PST mornings).
2) Deployment: Hosted API is fine for the pilot; security team will want to confirm SOC-2 docs before production, but pilot can use hosted.
3) Attendees: Me (PM), Sara Lin (engineer, cc'd), and our infra lead (Talia; she’s out today but I’ll add her to the invite once we confirm).

Preferred times: Fri Aug 21 — 11:00am PT works best for us. If you can do that slot, please send a calendar invite and a short pre-demo checklist (example: sample traffic profile, example payloads, what infra access if any).

Also — is there a short deck you can share ahead of the call?

Best,
Alex

Ben will send the official invite from my calendar and attach the deck. If Talia is available and wants to join, please add her to the event. Looking forward to it.
